dem.projection: SIMPLE CYLINDRICAL, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421, east longitude
dem.height_reference: km relative to the 1737.4 km sphere (label OFFSET)
dem.missing_data: label declares no MISSING_CONSTANT; values checked finite at the four interpolation pixels
dem.registration: J = LINE_PROJECTION_OFFSET - lat*res + 1, I = SAMPLE_PROJECTION_OFFSET + (lon - 180)*res + 1; tile corners on pixel edges (checked)

local_relief_m.note: height changes relative to the point; local relief, not coordinate uncertainty or accuracy

horizons_altitude.surface_elevation_reference: height above the 1737.4 km sphere (sldem2015_512_00n_30n_000_045_float, bilinear)
horizons_altitude.rule: surface rounded to 0.1 m, plus the nominal observer height (same rule as site_elevation.py)

use: observer altitude for Horizons positions only; no terrain horizon, mesh or slope is derived from this DEM in release 6
